summary: Detailed screen-by-screen UI and UX design specifications for Noor: Top App Bar with location and Hijri date, 5-Tab Material 3 Bottom Navigation (Prayers, Quran, Hadith, Devotionals, Community), full-bleed Hero Countdown Card, floating Reciter Audio Bar, and the comprehensive Islamic Suite Hub Grid housing all 35 specialized tools with Imperial Emerald and Sand Gold theming.
